explanation: Compared with erdosproblems.com/1026: van Doorn's precise form asks for the largest c with max(Σx_{i_r})>(c-o(1))(1/√n)Σx_i for sequences of n real numbers, and the page concludes c=1. Lean restricts to distinct positive sequences, unlike the page's 'real numbers'. The docstring justifies this (for all-negative sequences no c would work) and the proved Cambie conjecture on the page is for positive numbers. o(1) is modelled as uniform ε, and the weak inequality is immaterial. A documented precision of an ambiguous source.
